basis: C017 records exact known-page evidence that plaintext F can be copied without advancing a clock, while ordinary encryption can also produce ciphertext F.
H007 tested the same ambiguity as a finite state model for a prime stream, but did not test a periodic repeating key.
H014 tested FIRFUMFERENFE with deterministic ciphertext-F consume/free policies; it did not preserve both inverse paths for each ciphertext F.
hypothesis: The fixed FIRFUMFERENFE subtractive repeating-key model remains compatible with LP2 when plaintext F is an exception that is copied without consuming the 13-position key clock; unknown ciphertext F positions must therefore be represented by both legal inverse transitions.
falsifiable_predictions: A private synthetic ciphertext encrypted with the fixed key and containing both copied plaintext-F exceptions and ordinary non-F plaintexts that encrypt to ciphertext F has its generating path reachable under both continuity branches.
The preregistered incompatible ciphertext [1,10] has no terminal state from phase 0 because the second symbol would decode to forbidden plaintext F at key phase 1.

All 55 applicable LP2 pages are evaluated under page-reset and numeric-order continuous branches; at least one of the 56 registered statistic units must have maxT-adjusted p<=0.01 to count as a diagnostic lead.
A surviving state is compatibility evidence only; no LP2 page is accepted as decrypted without an independent plaintext or structural prediction.

sources.role: Previously frozen public key and deterministic F policy; this experiment adds the finite-state ambiguity.
Pinned LP2 raw corpus and page applicability.
C017 known-page exception evidence; read for registration only.

applicable_objects: All 55 pages containing registered rune tokens, including rune portions of mixed literal pages LP2/49 and LP2/51.

excluded_objects.reason: Pinned source has no registered rune tokens; its literal alphanumeric grid is outside this rune-domain state model and is unexecuted, not negative.

representation: Original rune ordinal indices 0..28 only; all non-rune characters remain outside the public state sequence and are not silently deleted or rewritten.

key.label: FIRFUMFERENFE
key.phase_domain: r in 0..12; consuming a normal transition advances r modulo 13

state_model.normal_transition: For input c, p=(c-K[r]) mod29 is legal only when p!=0; it consumes one key phase and advances r.
state_model.plaintext_f_exception: Only when c=0, emit p=0 without consuming the key phase; retain this transition together with any legal normal transition.
state_model.merge: Merge states with equal processed position and phase; cap path multiplicity per phase at 2 for ambiguity diagnostics.
state_model.literals: Non-rune characters do not enter the state sequence and do not consume phase.

algorithm_version: H016-v1: repeating 13-rune key finite-state inverse with copied plaintext-F exception; no key search, skip-mask search, dictionary, language completion or output-selected exception set.

statistics.metric: Longest legal prefix ratio per page-reset page and for the complete continuous corpus; a complete path has ratio 1.0.
statistics.units: 55 page-reset units plus 1 continuous whole-corpus unit; continuous downstream pages after an empty prefix are marked not_reached and are not treated as independent negatives.
statistics.maxT: Standardize observed and 999 control metric vectors together; compare each observed unit with the maximum control z across all 56 units using plus-one p and fixed tie tolerance 1e-12.
statistics.lead: A complete control set and maxT-adjusted p<=0.01 is an exploratory compatibility lead only; it is not a decryption acceptance criterion.
statistics.negative: Complete controls, passed independent validation and no lead is negative only for this exact key, transition rule, two continuity branches and fixed F-mask permutation null.

controls.random_null: For every page, keep ciphertext-F positions fixed and uniformly shuffle only the multiset of nonzero rune values among the remaining positions; preserve page length and page boundaries.
controls.synthetic_positive: Verifier-only deterministic plaintexts include at least one copied plaintext F and at least one nonzero plaintext whose fixed-key normal encryption produces ciphertext F; expected paths never enter the worker.
controls.impossible_control: Public one-page ciphertext [1,10] must have no terminal state from phase 0.
controls.independent: A separate set-based recurrence recomputes every observed state summary; a direct encryptor checks synthetic positive paths and a direct transition check confirms the impossible control.

randomness.role: Observed/control page permutations only; never passed to worker and never used as key or plaintext seed.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner writes specification, source/data hashes, public ciphertext jobs, verifier-only expected paths, code snapshot and control seed before invoking the guarded worker or calculating control statistics.
independent_validation_path: The worker uses a guarded phase-set implementation; the orchestrator uses a separate set recurrence and direct path arithmetic, with exact field-by-field comparison and no worker access to verifier-only files.

total_budget.state_transition_upper_bound: At most two outgoing transitions per reachable phase and rune; no complete exception-mask enumeration.

uncovered_parameters: Other keys, directions, offsets, periods and key derivations
Other F policies, unknown literal/grid consumption and alternative page orders
Feedback/autokey, multiplicative projections, PGL transforms and geometry
Independent LP2 plaintext, image-level glyph audit and LP2/50 literal grid
next_step: If a diagnostic lead survives controls, register an independent prediction and exact page before interpretation; otherwise move to a new method family without adding key or exception parameters to H016.
note: This is a finite-state compatibility diagnostic, not a plaintext search or decryption claim.
